recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a woman with voluminous curly hair, wearing a pale pink shaggy faux-fur coat and striped trousers, seated on a weathered terracotta velvet sofa against a dark green textured wall. The lighting is soft and directional, emphasizing the diverse tactile surfaces.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the soft, airy texture of the fur and the heavy, matte velvet of the sofa.
Color harmony between the muted pink of the coat and the warm terracotta of the upholstery.
The dark green background providing a cool-toned anchor to the warm-toned subject and furniture.
coreInvariants: Voluminous, natural curly hair framing the face.
Direct, neutral eye contact with the camera.
A palette restricted to forest green, terracotta, and dusty rose.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally positioned, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame vertically and horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hair serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the horizontal line of the sofa back.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, moves down through the texture of the fur coat, and follows the vertical stripes of the trousers toward the bottom of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the frame is dominated by a dark green textured wall, providing breathing room above the subject's head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Terracotta/Rust (sofa) provides the primary warm mid-tone.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Forest Green (background) acts as a complementary cool backdrop.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dusty Rose/Pale Pink (coat) provides a lighter, high-texture highlight.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low to medium saturation across all colors; deep values in the background contrasting with lighter values in the subject's clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright whites; use cream or off-white for highlights.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution portrait of a woman with large, dark curly hair wearing a pale pink shaggy faux-fur jacket and striped pants. She is sitting on a vintage, worn terracotta velvet sofa with gold braided trim. The background is a dark, textured forest green wall. Use soft, cinematic studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a high-contrast serif font in a cream color, positioned in the upper negative space of the green wall.

verificationChecks: Ensure the hair volume is significant and natural.
Check that the fur texture looks soft and individual strands are visible.
Verify the sofa texture appears as aged velvet rather than smooth fabric.
Confirm the background green is dark and matte.

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the green background texture
Width and color of the trouser stripes
Level of wear/distress on the velvet sofa
Length and shagginess of the faux-fur coat
postGenerationChecks: Does the fur look shaggy and voluminous?
Is the subject's gaze direct and engaging?
Is the lighting soft enough to preserve detail in the dark hair?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-texture garment (shag/fur) with a vintage textile background (velvet/tapestry) using a complementary muted color scheme (warm vs cool) for an editorial portrait.
